Title: A tabulation is added to a scheme, renamed and removed
Step Action: Open Manage Schemes > Schemes and click Details on the first scheme.
Step Expected: The scheme page opens.

Step Action: Open the Results Tabulations tab, click Add New Tabulation, enter a unique name and click Add Tabulation, then Save.
Step Expected: The tabulation is listed after a reload.

Step Action: Click Rename on it, enter a new name, click Rename Tabulation and Save.
Step Expected: The tabulation is listed under the new name.

Step Action: Click Remove on it, confirm and Save.
Step Expected: The tabulation is gone after a reload.

Step Action: Check the page.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: A test consultant of a scheme is changed, kept after reloading and restored
Step Action: Open Manage Schemes > Schemes and click Details on the first scheme.
Step Expected: The scheme page opens.

Step Action: Open the Test consultants tab and note the choice of the slot of the row.
Step Expected: The original choice is known.

Step Action: Choose another consultant in that slot and click Save.
Step Expected: The change is saved.

Step Action: Reload the scheme and open the tab again.
Step Expected: The slot shows the new choice.

Step Action: Put the original choice back and Save.
Step Expected: The original choice is stored.

Title: Apply and Cancel on a scheme tab keep the page without an error
Step Action: Open Manage Schemes > Schemes and click Details on the first scheme.
Step Expected: The scheme page opens.

Step Action: Open the tab of the row.
Step Expected: The tab shows.

Step Action: Click the action of the row (Apply or Cancel).
Step Expected: The action runs.

Step Action: Wait for the page to load.
Step Expected: The page loads.

Step Action: Check the page.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: A method item of a scheme test is moved down and back up
Step Action: Open Manage Schemes > Schemes and click Details on the first scheme.
Step Expected: The scheme page opens.

Step Action: Open the Tests tab.
Step Expected: The tests and their method items show.

Step Action: Click Move down on the first method item.
Step Expected: The item moves down.

Step Action: Click Move up on the item that is now second.
Step Expected: The original order is restored.

Step Action: Check the page.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: A test is added to a scheme and removed again
Step Action: Open Manage Schemes > Schemes and click Details on the first scheme.
Step Expected: The scheme page opens.

Step Action: Open the Tests tab and note the number of tests.
Step Expected: The count is known.

Step Action: Click Add New Test, choose the last test type and click Add Test.
Step Expected: The scheme shows one more test.

Step Action: Click Remove Test on the last test and confirm.
Step Expected: The scheme shows its original number of tests.

Step Action: Check the page.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: A result, method or category item is added to the first test and removed again
Step Action: Open Manage Schemes > Schemes and click Details on the first scheme.
Step Expected: The scheme page opens.

Step Action: Open the Tests tab and note the number of items of the kind of the row in the first test.
Step Expected: The count is known.

Step Action: Click the Add link of the kind, keep the first type and click the Add button.
Step Expected: The test shows one more item of that kind.

Step Action: Click Remove on the last item of that kind and confirm where asked.
Step Expected: The test shows its original number of items.

Step Action: Check the page.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: A criterion item is added to a new category of the first test and removed again
Step Action: Open Manage Schemes > Schemes and click Details on the first scheme.
Step Expected: The scheme page opens.

Step Action: Open the Tests tab, click Add Category Item on the first test and click Add Category.
Step Expected: A new category is listed last.

Step Action: Click Add Criterion Item on the new category, keep the first type and click Add Criterion.
Step Expected: The test shows one more criterion.

Step Action: Click Remove on the last criterion.
Step Expected: The test shows its original number of criteria.

Step Action: Click Remove on the new category and confirm.
Step Expected: The category is gone.

Step Action: Check the page.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.
